instruction: For each rule below, declare where it is verified. Use ONLY names from `evidence`. Omit a rule entirely rather than guess - an unresolvable trace is worse than none, because it reports as covered while nothing verifies the rule. Return JSON: { "proposals": [ { "id": "BR-...", "traces": { "ui": [], "api": [], "db": [], "tests": [] } } ] }

rules.text:
- id: BR-ASGN-001
    statement: Assignment Main tab displays a loan work queue with row-level detail fields for operational triage (Action, NOD Exp., Contract State, DPD, Principal Bal., Past Due Bal., Last Pay, Resident State, # of Payments Made, Last Worked, PTP Date, Region, Assigned To).
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-002
    statement: Each queue row displays the loan reference, customer name, vehicle description (year/make/model), VIN, GPS Installed status, and Serial Number.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-003
    statement: Loan Number is a hyperlink that navigates to the corresponding loan record in the dev3 environment for that loan.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-ASGN-004
    statement: Each row displays a disposition label (e.g. No Status) reflecting the account's current stage.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-ASGN-005
    statement: Each row displays the Assigned To representative with assignment date.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-006
    statement: Action is an editable per-row field constrained to the supported action list.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-007
    statement: The Notes icon on a row opens a Notes popup scoped to that loan, showing an Add Note entry field and cross-dashboard Notes History.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-008
    statement: Accounts become eligible for Assignment routing automatically when repo criteria are met at 40 DPD.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-009
    statement: An eligible account's region is determined from Contract State using the approved state-to-region mapping in specs/modules/common/loss-mitigation/state-to-region-map.yaml.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-010
    statement: Accounts route only to queue-eligible Asset Management associates within the matched region; queue-ineligible users (see specs/modules/common/loss-mitigation/queue-ineligible-users.yaml) never receive assignments.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-011
    statement: Within a matched region, an eligible account is assigned to the queue-eligible representative with the lowest active queue volume; when volumes tie, the account goes to the representative least recently assigned an account.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-012
    statement: Assignment and Repo share one combined queueing mechanism — a representative's active queue volume counts accounts on either dashboard as the same single count, not two separate per-dashboard counts.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-013
    statement: Upon assignment, the system creates and persists an account-to-representative assignment record (sticky ownership) that the account keeps throughout the repo lifecycle, across both Assignment and Repo dashboards.
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-014
    statement: Sticky ownership ends only when the repo case is closed, or the account reaches one of the final statuses (Secured – Involuntary, Secured – Voluntary, Secured – Impound, or an existing final status such as BK or Unable to Locate).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-015
    statement: If an account later re-enters the repo assignment process, the system generates a new Assignment ID, treats the account as a new workflow instance, and makes it eligible for reassignment using the standard routing rules (which may select a different representative than before).
    priority: Critical

- id: BR-ASGN-016
    statement: Once assigned, an account automatically populates the assigned representative's Repo Dashboard; Repo does not perform independent regional routing (see specs/modules/loss-mitigation/repo.yaml).
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-017
    statement: Last Worked Date remains associated with the assigned representative; moving an account from Assignment to Repo does not reset Last Worked Date, reassign ownership, or create a new Last Worked Date value.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-018
    statement: Assigned To, Region, Contract State, and Last Worked Date are visible table columns and filters on the Assignment Main tab, and a Last Worked > 7 Days indicator is shown per row.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-019
    statement: The Assigned To filter is pre-applied by default at screen load, scoped to the currently logged-in representative.
    priority: Medium

- id: BR-ASGN-020
    statement: CSV exports from the Assignment Dashboard include Assigned To, Region, Contract State, and Last Worked Date as columns.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-021
    statement: When a note is created from the Assignment Dashboard, the system automatically includes an "Assignment:" dashboard-source identifier in the note text, visible in note history.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-022
    statement: Queue-ineligible users (Managers, Associate Managers, Team Leads, designated Senior Associates — see specs/modules/common/loss-mitigation/queue-ineligible-users.yaml) retain view and update access to the Assignment Dashboard but never receive account assignments.
    priority: High

- id: BR-ASGN-023
    statement: A user can manually send an account into Assignment when the repossession account's status changes to Out to Repo, regardless of DPD value — this manual path bypasses the 40 DPD threshold entirely (see BR-ASGN-008 for the automatic path).
    priority: Critical
